name: tau-schedule
description: Chats wake themselves later, with a note

tools.name: schedule
tools.description: Wake this chat later, once, with a note to yourself for then: `in` a while, or `on` a local date and time. When it comes, this chat takes a turn whose message is your note, after any turn going ends. Use it when work waits on something: a review, a release, a long build. Scheduling a name again replaces it. The person sees what you scheduled beside the chat and may cancel it.

note.description: What to do then, for you to read when it comes.

on.description: At this local date and time: `2026-10-13 09:00`.

tools.name: scheduled
tools.description: What this chat has scheduled with `schedule` that is still to come, soonest first, and the host's local time now. Look before you schedule something again.

tools.name: unschedule
tools.description: Cancel what this chat scheduled as `name`.
